-------------------------DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),AVE_CLR_BALANCE)),0) AVE_CLR_BALANCE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),AVE_CURR_BALANCE)),0) AVE_CURR_BALANCE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NO_DAYS)),0) NO_DAYS_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, AVE_CLR_BALANCE AVE_CLR_BALANCE_src
, AVE_CURR_BALANCE AVE_CURR_BALANCE_src
, NO_DAYS NO_DAYS_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, AVE_CLR_BALANCE_tgt
, AVE_CURR_BALANCE_tgt
, NO_DAYS_tgt
, AVE_CLR_BALANCE_src
, AVE_CURR_BALANCE_src
, NO_DAYS_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(AVE_CLR_BALANCE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVE_CLR_BALANCE_tgt
,CAST(AVE_CURR_BALANCE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVE_CURR_BALANCE_tgt
,CAST(NO_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NO_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(AVE_CLR_BALANCE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVE_CLR_BALANCE_src
,CAST(AVE_CURR_BALANCE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVE_CURR_BALANCE_src
,CAST(NO_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NO_DAYS_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, AVE_CLR_BALANCE_src
, AVE_CURR_BALANCE_src
, NO_DAYS_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, AVE_CLR_BALANCE_tgt
, AVE_CURR_BALANCE_tgt
, NO_DAYS_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
